description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is the liquor retail brand of Otter Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative serving communities across BC including Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley, and several Interior towns. The West Railway branch sits at 2520 Montvue Avenue in Chilliwack and offers beer, wine, and spirits. As part of a multi-location regional co-op, it caters primarily to neighbourhood retail customers.
